page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.t6-c1m4.large is a burstable instance type built on the KVM hypervisor. It features an x86_64 architecture powered by an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at 2.5 GHz. The instance is configured with 2 vCPUs derived from 1 physical core with hyper-threading enabled, providing 2.0 threads per core. It includes 8.0 GB of system memory, providing 4.0 GB of RAM per core. No local storage or GPUs are bundled with this instance, and the baseline network bandwidth is rated at 0 Gbps.

Benchmark results place this instance in the lower performance tiers. In stress-ng testing, the single-core CPU performance scored 1161.28, while multi-core performance registered at 2371.48. Memory bandwidth tests show 187.49 GB/sec for cached small-block reads, dropping to 22.38 GB/sec for uncached large-block reads. Geekbench testing yielded a single-core score of 1092.0 and a multi-core score of 1822.0. Cryptographic and database operations also show limited throughput, with a Passmark database operations score of 701.22 and Redis SET operations reaching 2.61 million operations per second.

Due to its burstable CPU allocation and lower-tier benchmark performance, this instance represents a budget-friendly option for workloads with low baseline CPU utilization that require occasional bursts. It is not designed for sustained high-performance computing, large-scale database hosting, or intensive data processing. Appropriate workloads include lightweight web serving, development and testing environments, code compilation tasks, and low-traffic background services.
